Hon'ble Siddharth,J.
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned AGA for the State.

2. The instant application under Section 482 has been has been filed by the applicant with the prayer to quash the impugned order dated 07.03.2024 passed by the Court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate- Vth, Jaunpur, in criminal case no. 146 of 2023 (State Vs. Alok Kumar Maurya and another), under section- 406, 420, 504 of IPC, Police Station- Shahaganj, District- Jaunpur,
arising out of case crime no. 0339/2022, pending in the court of Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate- Vth, Jaunpur.

sentences.text: 3. After hearing learned counsel for the parties, this Court finds that it is not a fit case for quashing the entire proceedings in the aforesaid case.

5. However, on the request of learned counsel for the appellant, it is directed that in case appellant appears and surrenders before the court below within 60 days from today and applying for regular bail, his bail application shall be considered as per judgement and order of Apex Court in the case of Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, judgement dated 11.7.2022.

entities.text: Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: 6. For a period of 60 days, the applicant shall not be arrested in the aforesaid case, if not already arrested.
7. However, in case, the applicant does not appears before the court below within the aforesaid period, coercive action shall be taken against him.
8. It is made clear that the applicant will not be granted any further time by this Court for surrendering before the court below as directed above.

opennyai_summary.decision:
4. This application is dismissed.
5. However, on the request of learned counsel for the appellant, it is directed that in case appellant appears and surrenders before the court below within 60 days from today and applying for regular bail, his bail application shall be considered as per judgement and order of Apex Court in the case of Satendra Kumar Antil Vs. C.B.I. & Another, passed in S.L.P.(Crl.) No. 5191 of 2021, judgement dated 11.7.2022.
6. For a period of 60 days, the applicant shall not be arrested in the aforesaid case, if not already arrested.
7. However, in case, the applicant does not appears before the court below within the aforesaid period, coercive action shall be taken against him.
8. It is made clear that the applicant will not be granted any further time by this Court for surrendering before the court below as directed above.
